title: Ravana sends his son Aksha
introduction: Ravana sends Aksha, his own son, to fight against Hanuma. Aksha, along with his army elephants and horses, approach Hanuma and incites him to battle by discharging three sharp arrows. As Aksha discharges his arrows, Hanuma bounces quickly to the sky and smashes Aksha, his chariot and the horses with blows. After killing Aksha, Hanuma returns again to the same archy door-way.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 47th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सेना पतीन् पन्च स तु प्रमापितान् |
हनूमता सानुचरान् सवाहनान् |
समीक्ष्य राजा समर उद्धत उन्मुखम् |
कुमारम् अक्षम् प्रसमैक्षत अक्षतम्
verses.iast:
senā patīn panca sa tu pramāpitān |
hanūmatā sānucarān savāhanān |
samīkṣya rājā samara uddhata unmukham |
kumāram akṣam prasamaikṣata akṣatam
verses.translation: Hearing and sustaining that the five army-generals along with their followers and vehicles were disposed off by Hanuma, Ravana looked at Aksha, his son, violent in combat and who was inclined to fighting as well as sitting in front of him.

glosses.meaning: who was sitting in front of him
who was violent in combat and inclined to fighting.

verses.devanagari:
स तस्य दृष्टि अर्पण सम्प्रचोदितः |
प्रतापवान् कान्चन चित्र कार्मुकः |
समुत्पपात अथ सदसि उदीरितो |
द्विजाति मुख्यैः हविषा इव पावकः
verses.iast:
sa tasya dṛṣṭi arpaṇa sampracoditaḥ |
pratāpavān kāncana citra kārmukaḥ |
samutpapāta atha sadasi udīrito |
dvijāti mukhyaiḥ haviṣā iva pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: Goaded by the looks of Ravana, the energetic Aksha, wielding a golden dotted bow, quickly sprang up, like a fire switched up by the foremost of brahmins in a sacrificial fire, by offering oblations to it.

verses.devanagari:
ततो महत् बाल दिवा कर प्रभम् |
प्रतप्त जाम्बू नद जाल सम्ततम् |
रथाम् समास्थाय ययौ स वीर्यवान् |
महाहरिम् तम् प्रति नैरृत ऋषभः
verses.iast:
tato mahat bāla divā kara prabham |
pratapta jāmbū nada jāla samtatam |
rathām samāsthāya yayau sa vīryavān |
mahāharim tam prati nairṛta ṛṣabhaḥ
verses.translation: Mounting a great chariot, having a splendour of a newly risen sun and overlaid with a protective armour of highly refined gold, that valiant cheif of demons sallied forth towards that mighty monkey.

glosses.meaning: having a splendour of a newly risen sun
and overlaid with a protective armour of highly refined gold

verses.devanagari:
ततः तपः सम्ग्रह संचय अर्जितम् |
प्रतप्त जाम्बू नद जाल शोभितम् |
पताकिनम् रत्न विभूषित ध्वजम् |
मनो जव अष्ट अश्व वरैः सुयोजितम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tapaḥ samgraha saṃcaya arjitam |
pratapta jāmbū nada jāla śobhitam |
patākinam ratna vibhūṣita dhvajam |
mano java aṣṭa aśva varaiḥ suyojitam
verses.translation: Aksha's chariot was earned through many kinds of his penances. It was shining with a protective armour of highly refined gold, adorned with a flag on a flag-staff studded with gems and yoked well with eight excellent horses, having speed equal to that of a mind.

glosses.meaning: was earned by many kinds of his penances
shining with a protective armour of highly refined gold
on a flag-staff studded with gems

verses.devanagari:
सुर असुर अधृष्यम् असम्ग चारिणम् |
रवि प्रभम् व्योम चरम् समाहितम् |
सतूणम् अष्ट असि निबद्ध बन्धुरम् |
यथा क्रम आवेशित शक्ति तोमरम्
verses.iast:
sura asura adhṛṣyam asamga cāriṇam |
ravi prabham vyoma caram samāhitam |
satūṇam aṣṭa asi nibaddha bandhuram |
yathā krama āveśita śakti tomaram
verses.translation: That chariot was unassailable by celestials or demons. It moved without hindrance to any place. It shone like a sun and could move within the sky. It was well-conceived with a quiver, eight swords and tied with bells. It was orderly arranged with spears and lances in their respective places.

glosses.meaning: (that chariot) cannot be attacked by celestials or demons
It has a shining similar to the sun
It can move within the sky
arranged well in order with spears and lances.

verses.devanagari:
विराजमानम् प्रतिपूर्ण वस्तुना |
सहेम दाम्ना शशि सूर्य वर्वसा |
दिवा कर आभम् रथम् आस्थितः ततः |
स निर्जगाम अमर तुल्य विक्रमः
verses.iast:
virājamānam pratipūrṇa vastunā |
sahema dāmnā śaśi sūrya varvasā |
divā kara ābham ratham āsthitaḥ tataḥ |
sa nirjagāma amara tulya vikramaḥ
verses.translation: Then, Aksha having a prowess equal to that of celestials, came forth, mounting that chariot decorated with golden wreaths, having a brilliance of moon and sun, filled with every right thing and shining like rays of sun.

glosses.meaning: with a brilliance of the moon and the sun

verses.devanagari:
स पूरयन् खम् च महीम् च साचलाम् |
तुरम्ग मतन्ग महारथ स्वनैः |
बलैः समेतैः स हि तोरण स्थितम् |
समर्थम् आसीनम् उपागमत् कपिम्
verses.iast:
sa pūrayan kham ca mahīm ca sācalām |
turamga matanga mahāratha svanaiḥ |
balaiḥ sametaiḥ sa hi toraṇa sthitam |
samartham āsīnam upāgamat kapim
verses.translation: Aksha, filling the sky earth and its mountains with sounds of horses elephants and chariots, together with his army, approached the efficient Hanuma the great monkey, standing at the archy door-way.

glosses.meaning: who was standing at the archy door-way.

verses.devanagari:
स तम् समासाद्य हरिम् हरि ईक्षणो |
युग अन्त काल अग्निम् इव प्रजा क्षये |
अवस्थितम् विस्मित जात सम्भ्रमः |
समैक्षत अक्षो बहु मान चक्षुषा
verses.iast:
sa tam samāsādya harim hari īkṣaṇo |
yuga anta kāla agnim iva prajā kṣaye |
avasthitam vismita jāta sambhramaḥ |
samaikṣata akṣo bahu māna cakṣuṣā
verses.translation: Approaching that Hanuma, standing there readily to destroy mortals, similar to a fire that is to destroy the world, the yellow-eyed Aksha was bewildered, born of a surprise and looked to him with a great esteem.

glosses.meaning: like a fire that is to destroy the world
was bewildered born of a surprise

verses.devanagari:
स तस्य वेगम् च कपेः महात्मनः |
पराक्रमम् चारिषु पार्ह्तिव आत्मजः |
विचारयन् खम् च बलम् महाबलो |
हिम क्षये सूर्य इव अभिवर्धते
verses.iast:
sa tasya vegam ca kapeḥ mahātmanaḥ |
parākramam cāriṣu pārhtiva ātmajaḥ |
vicārayan kham ca balam mahābalo |
hima kṣaye sūrya iva abhivardhate
verses.translation: That Aksha, the mighty prince, assessing the swiftness of that high-souled Hanuma and his prowess with regard to his adversaries as also his own strength, increased his body more and more like the sun when the frost is faded away.

glosses.meaning: increased his body more and more
like the sun when the frost is faded away.

verses.devanagari:
स जात मन्युः प्रसमीक्ष्य विक्रमम् |
स्थिरः स्थितः सम्यति दुर्निवारणम् |
समाहित आत्मा हनुमन्तम् आहवे |
प्रचोदयामास शरैः त्रिभिः शितैः
verses.iast:
sa jāta manyuḥ prasamīkṣya vikramam |
sthiraḥ sthitaḥ samyati durnivāraṇam |
samāhita ātmā hanumantam āhave |
pracodayāmāsa śaraiḥ tribhiḥ śitaiḥ
verses.translation: Understanding Hanuma's prowess to be unrestrainable and stable in battle, that Aksha, exhibiting anger initially, became stable and mentally composed and incited Hanuma to battle by discharging three sharp arrows towards him.

glosses.meaning: tribhiH sharaiH = by discharging three sharp arrows.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कपिम् तम् प्रसमीक्ष्य गर्वितम् |
जित श्रमम् शत्रु पराजयोः जितम् |
अवैक्षत अक्षः समुदीर्ण मानसः |
सबाण पाणिः प्रगृहीत कार्मुकः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kapim tam prasamīkṣya garvitam |
jita śramam śatru parājayoḥ jitam |
avaikṣata akṣaḥ samudīrṇa mānasaḥ |
sabāṇa pāṇiḥ pragṛhīta kārmukaḥ
verses.translation: Recognizing that Hanuma, as a haughty monkey, after having gallantly conquered his adversaries and accustomed to fatigue, that Aksha, graspign the bow and arrows his hand, saw him with an excited mind.

glosses.meaning: after having gallantly conquered his adversaries

verses.devanagari:
स हेम निष्क अन्गद चारु कुण्डलः |
समाससाद आशु पराक्रमः कपिम् |
तयोः बभूव अप्रतिमः समागमः |
सुर असुराणाम् अपि सम्भ्रम प्रदः
verses.iast:
sa hema niṣka angada cāru kuṇḍalaḥ |
samāsasāda āśu parākramaḥ kapim |
tayoḥ babhūva apratimaḥ samāgamaḥ |
sura asurāṇām api sambhrama pradaḥ
verses.translation: Having a glden chain, a pair of armlets and charming ear-rings, Aksha of a swift prowess, approached Hanuma. Their unmatched get-together in combat became a baffle to even the celestials and demons.

glosses.meaning: to even the celestials and demons.

verses.devanagari:
ररास भूमिः न तताप भानुमान् |
ववौ न वायुः प्रचचाल च अचलः |
कपेः कुमारस्य च वीक्ष्य सम्युगम् |
ननाद च द्यौः उदधिः च चुक्षुभे
verses.iast:
rarāsa bhūmiḥ na tatāpa bhānumān |
vavau na vāyuḥ pracacāla ca acalaḥ |
kapeḥ kumārasya ca vīkṣya samyugam |
nanāda ca dyauḥ udadhiḥ ca cukṣubhe
verses.translation: Seeing that battle between Hanuma and Aksha, the earth uproared. The sun did not shine brightly. The wind ceased to blow. The mountain shook. The sky made a reverberant sound. The ocean too was agitated.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स वीरः सुमुखान् पतत्रिणः |
सुवर्ण पुन्खान् सविषान् इव उरगान् |
समाधि सम्योग विमोक्ष तत्त्ववित् |
शरान् अथ त्रीन् कपि मूर्ध्नि अपातयत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa vīraḥ sumukhān patatriṇaḥ |
suvarṇa punkhān saviṣān iva uragān |
samādhi samyoga vimokṣa tattvavit |
śarān atha trīn kapi mūrdhni apātayat
verses.translation: Then, that eminent demon, who correctly knew how to fix his gaze on the target, to fit an arrow to the bow and to discharge it, hurled on Hanuma's head, three arrows which were well-painted, having golden shafts and feathers and which resembled venomous serpants.

glosses.meaning: who correctly knew how to fix his gaze on the target

verses.devanagari:
स तैः शरैः मूर्ध्नि समम् निपातितैः |
क्षरन्न् असृग् दिग्ध विवृत्त लोचनः |
नव उदित आदित्य निभः शर अंशुमान् |
व्यराजत आदित्य इव अंशु मालिकः
verses.iast:
sa taiḥ śaraiḥ mūrdhni samam nipātitaiḥ |
kṣarann asṛg digdha vivṛtta locanaḥ |
nava udita āditya nibhaḥ śara aṃśumān |
vyarājata āditya iva aṃśu mālikaḥ
verses.translation: Oozing the blood from his wound caused by those arrows descended into his head (by Aksha), looking like the newly risen sun, his eyes bathed in blood rolling rapidly, Hanuma shone brightly like the sun surrounded by a circle of rays, having the arrows as its rays.

glosses.meaning: oozing the blood from his wounds
looking like the newly risen su
surrounded by a circle of rays
having the arrows as its rays.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स पिन्ग अधिप मन्त्रि सत्तमः |
समीक्ष्य तम् राज वर आत्मजम् रणे |
उदग्र चित्र आयुध चित्र कार्मुकम् |
जहर्ष च आपूर्यत च आहव उन्मुखः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa pinga adhipa mantri sattamaḥ |
samīkṣya tam rāja vara ātmajam raṇe |
udagra citra āyudha citra kārmukam |
jaharṣa ca āpūryata ca āhava unmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing in the battle that Aksha the prince, with his marvellous weapons and picturesque bow, that Hanuma the excellent one among Sugree's counsellors, was rejoiced and with an inclination to fight, grew in size.

glosses.meaning: with his marvelllous weapons and picturesque bow
the excellent one among Sugreeva's ministers
and with an inclination to fight

verses.devanagari:
स मन्दर अग्रस्थ इव अंशु माली |
विवृद्ध कोपो बल वीर्य सम्युतः |
कुमारम् अक्षम् सबलम् सवाहनम् |
ददाह नेत्र अग्नि मरीचिभिः तदा
verses.iast:
sa mandara agrastha iva aṃśu mālī |
vivṛddha kopo bala vīrya samyutaḥ |
kumāram akṣam sabalam savāhanam |
dadāha netra agni marīcibhiḥ tadā
verses.translation: That Hanuma, endowed with strength and prowess, resembling the sun appearing on a peak of Mandara muntain and whose anger was increased, then burnt the prince Aksha along with his army and vehicles, by the rays of fire emnating from his eyes.

glosses.meaning: appearing on a peak of Mandara mountain
by the rays of fire emnating from his eyes

verses.devanagari:
ततः स बाण आसन शक्र कार्मुकः |
शर प्रवर्षो युधि राक्षस अम्बुदः |
शरान् मुमोच आशु हरि ईश्वर अचले |
बलाहको वृष्टिम् इव अचल उत्तमे
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa bāṇa āsana śakra kārmukaḥ |
śara pravarṣo yudhi rākṣasa ambudaḥ |
śarān mumoca āśu hari īśvara acale |
balāhako vṛṣṭim iva acala uttame
verses.translation: That demon in the form of a cloud, raining down arrows, then wielding a bow in the form of a rain-bow, soon discharged arrows on Hanuma standing in the form of a mountain, like a cloud showering rain on a high mountain.

glosses.meaning: that demon in the form of a cloud
wielding a bow in the form of a rain bow
on Hanuma in the form of a mountain

verses.devanagari:
ततः कपिः तम् रण चण्ड विक्रमम् |
विवृद्ध तेजो बल वीर्य सायकम् |
कुमारम् अक्षम् प्रसमीक्ष्य सम्युगे |
ननाद हर्षात् घन तुल्य विक्रमः
verses.iast:
tataḥ kapiḥ tam raṇa caṇḍa vikramam |
vivṛddha tejo bala vīrya sāyakam |
kumāram akṣam prasamīkṣya samyuge |
nanāda harṣāt ghana tulya vikramaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that Aksha the prince, possessing an impetuous valour, endowed with enhanced splendour strength and vigour with a capacity to move within the sky like a cloud, coming to the battle, Hanuma roared with joy.

glosses.meaning: wandering in the sky like a cloud

verses.devanagari:
स बाल भावात् युधि वीर्य दर्पितः |
प्रवृद्ध मन्युः क्षतज उपम ईक्षणः |
समाससाद अप्रतिमम् रणे कपिम् |
गजो महाकूपम् इव आवृतम् तृणैः
verses.iast:
sa bāla bhāvāt yudhi vīrya darpitaḥ |
pravṛddha manyuḥ kṣataja upama īkṣaṇaḥ |
samāsasāda apratimam raṇe kapim |
gajo mahākūpam iva āvṛtam tṛṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Boastful of his valour in battle because of his childish attitude, Aksha wit an enhanced fury and red-blood eyes, approached Hanuma who was incomparable in battle, as an elephant approaching a well covered with heaps of straw.

verses.devanagari:
स तेन बाणैः प्रसभम् निपातितैः |
चकार नादम् घन नाद निह्स्वनः |
समुत्पपात आशु नभः स मारुतिः |
भुज ऊरु विक्षेपण घोर दर्शनः
verses.iast:
sa tena bāṇaiḥ prasabham nipātitaiḥ |
cakāra nādam ghana nāda nihsvanaḥ |
samutpapāta āśu nabhaḥ sa mārutiḥ |
bhuja ūru vikṣepaṇa ghora darśanaḥ
verses.translation: As Aksha forcefully discharged his arrows, Hanuma roared a sound of thunder and bounced quickly to the sky assuming a terrible sight, stretching out his arms and thighs.

glosses.meaning: like the sound of a thunder

verses.devanagari:
समुत्पतन्तम् समभिद्रवत् बली |
स राक्षसानाम् प्रवरः प्रतापवान् |
रथी रथ श्रेष्ठतमः किरन् शरैः |
पयो धरः शैलम् इव अश्म वृष्टिभिः
verses.iast:
samutpatantam samabhidravat balī |
sa rākṣasānām pravaraḥ pratāpavān |
rathī ratha śreṣṭhatamaḥ kiran śaraiḥ |
payo dharaḥ śailam iva aśma vṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: That strong and valiant Aksha, the foremost among the demons, and the best among car warriors, went chasing Hanuma who was flying upwards, difusing arrows like a cloud showering hail-stones on a mountian.

verses.devanagari:
स तान् शरान् तस्य विमोक्षयन् कपिः |
चचार वीरः पथि वायु सेविते |
शर अन्तरे मारुतवत् विनिष्पतन् |
मनो जवः सम्यति चण्ड विक्रमः
verses.iast:
sa tān śarān tasya vimokṣayan kapiḥ |
cacāra vīraḥ pathi vāyu sevite |
śara antare mārutavat viniṣpatan |
mano javaḥ samyati caṇḍa vikramaḥ
verses.translation: That valiant Hanuma, whose swiftness was equal to the mind and possessing impetuous valour in battle, rushing forth like wind in the space between one arrow and another and thus escaping Aksha's arrows, moved in the path visited by wind (the sky).

glosses.meaning: who has a swiftness equal to the mind
in the space between one arrow and another

verses.devanagari:
तम् आत्त बाण आसनम् आहव उन्मुखम् |
खम् आस्तृणन्तम् विविधैः शर उत्तमैः |
अवैक्षत अक्षम् बहु मान चक्षुषा |
जगाम चिन्ताम् च स मारुत आत्मजः
verses.iast:
tam ātta bāṇa āsanam āhava unmukham |
kham āstṛṇantam vividhaiḥ śara uttamaiḥ |
avaikṣata akṣam bahu māna cakṣuṣā |
jagāma cintām ca sa māruta ātmajaḥ
verses.translation: With a respectful faculty of sight, Hanuma saw that Aksha who was wielding his bow and readily inclined to fight, covering the entire sky with excellent arrows with various types of tops and became thoughful.

glosses.meaning: with a respectful faculty of sight

verses.devanagari:
ततः शरैः भिन्न भुज अन्तरः कपिः |
कुमार वर्येण महात्मना नदन् |
महाभुजः कर्म विशेष तत्त्ववित् |
विचिन्तयामास रणे पराक्रमम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ śaraiḥ bhinna bhuja antaraḥ kapiḥ |
kumāra varyeṇa mahātmanā nadan |
mahābhujaḥ karma viśeṣa tattvavit |
vicintayāmāsa raṇe parākramam
verses.translation: Then, the mighty armed Hanuma, who knew how to act under particular circumstances, roaring when pierced in the breast with shafts by the high souled heroic, Aksha, reflected on the prowess of his adversary in battle.

glosses.meaning: who knew how to act under particular circumstances
when pierced in the breast with shafts

verses.devanagari:
अबालवत् बाल दिवा कर प्रभः |
करोति अयम् कर्म महन् महाबलः |
न च अस्य सर्व आहव कर्म शोभिनः |
प्रमापणे मे मतिः अत्र जायते
verses.iast:
abālavat bāla divā kara prabhaḥ |
karoti ayam karma mahan mahābalaḥ |
na ca asya sarva āhava karma śobhinaḥ |
pramāpaṇe me matiḥ atra jāyate
verses.translation: "The mighty Aksha, possessing the lustre of a rising sun, is performing a great act, as a mature youth. My mind is not conceding here to kill him, who is distinguished in all acts of war-fare."

glosses.meaning: possessing the lustre of a rising sun
who is distinguished in all acts of war fare.

verses.devanagari:
अयम् महात्मा च महान् च वीर्यतः |
समाहितः च अतिसहः च सम्युगे |
असंशयम् कर्म गुण उदयात् अयम् |
सनाग यक्षैः मुनिभिः च पूजितः
verses.iast:
ayam mahātmā ca mahān ca vīryataḥ |
samāhitaḥ ca atisahaḥ ca samyuge |
asaṃśayam karma guṇa udayāt ayam |
sanāga yakṣaiḥ munibhiḥ ca pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: "He possesses a great intellect and is also prominent by his valour. He is well-composed and highly tolerant in battle. Due to his eminent deeds and virtues, he is undoubtedly adored by saints, Nagas the serpent-demons and Yakshas the semi-dviine being."

glosses.meaning: and is prominent viiryataH cha = by his valour too
due to eminence in his deeds and virtues
along with Nagas the serpent-demons and Yakshas the semi-divine beings.

verses.devanagari:
पराक्रम उत्साह विवृद्ध मानसः |
समीक्षते माम् प्रमुख आगतः स्थितः |
पराक्रमो हि अस्य मनांसि कम्पयेत् |
सुर असुराणाम् अपि शीघ्र कारिणः
verses.iast:
parākrama utsāha vivṛddha mānasaḥ |
samīkṣate mām pramukha āgataḥ sthitaḥ |
parākramo hi asya manāṃsi kampayet |
sura asurāṇām api śīghra kāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: "He is standing very much before me and looks me straight in the eyes, reassured as he is, by his prowess and enthusiasm. His swift-moving prowess trembles even the minds of celestials and demons."

glosses.meaning: straight in eyes reassured as he is

verses.devanagari:
न खल्व् अयम् न अभिभवेत् उपेक्षितः |
पराक्रमो हि अस्य रणे विवर्धते |
प्रमापणम् तु एव मम अस्य रोचते |
न वर्धमानो अग्निः उपेक्षितुम् क्षमः
verses.iast:
na khalv ayam na abhibhavet upekṣitaḥ |
parākramo hi asya raṇe vivardhate |
pramāpaṇam tu eva mama asya rocate |
na vardhamāno agniḥ upekṣitum kṣamaḥ
verses.translation: 'If neglected, he would undoubtedly overpower me. His prowess is getting augmented in battle. The only option left out for me is to kill him now. It is not proper to neglect a spreadin fire."

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रवेगम् तु परस्य तर्कयन् |
स्व कर्म योगम् च विधाय वीर्यवान् |
चकार वेगम् तु महाबलः तदा |
मतिम् च चक्रे अस्य वधे महाकपिः
verses.iast:
iti pravegam tu parasya tarkayan |
sva karma yogam ca vidhāya vīryavān |
cakāra vegam tu mahābalaḥ tadā |
matim ca cakre asya vadhe mahākapiḥ
verses.translation: The valiant and te mighty Hanuma, reflecting thus about the swiftness of the adersary and determining his own couse of action, then acquired a course of action, then acquired a momentum and also made up his mind to kill him.

glosses.meaning: about the rapidity of the adversary

verses.devanagari:
स तस्य तान् अष्ट हयान् महाजवान् |
समाहितान् भार सहान् विवर्तने |
जघान वीरः पथि वायु सेविते |
तल प्रहालैः पवन आत्मजः कपिः
verses.iast:
sa tasya tān aṣṭa hayān mahājavān |
samāhitān bhāra sahān vivartane |
jaghāna vīraḥ pathi vāyu sevite |
tala prahālaiḥ pavana ātmajaḥ kapiḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma, the heroic son of wind, killed using the blows of his palm, those eight horses posessing a great speed in the path of sky with alertness as also having a capacity to bear burden while turning to different directions.

glosses.meaning: by the slap of his palm

verses.devanagari:
ततः तलेन अभिहतो महारथः |
स तस्य पिन्ग अधिप मन्त्रि निर्जितः |
स भग्न नीडः परिमुक्त कूबरः |
पपात भूमौ हत वाजिः अम्बरात्
verses.iast:
tataḥ talena abhihato mahārathaḥ |
sa tasya pinga adhipa mantri nirjitaḥ |
sa bhagna nīḍaḥ parimukta kūbaraḥ |
papāta bhūmau hata vājiḥ ambarāt
verses.translation: Then, the great chariot of Aksha, thus struck by the palm and subdued by Hanuma the counsellor of Sugreeva, had its interior broken, its carriage pole loosened and its horses dead and fallen from the sky to the ground.

verses.devanagari:
स तम् परित्यज्य महारथो रथम् |
सकार्मुकः खड्ग धरः खम् उत्पतत् |
तपो अभियोगात् ऋषिः उग्र वीर्यवान् |
विहाय देहम् मरुताम् इव आलयम्
verses.iast:
sa tam parityajya mahāratho ratham |
sakārmukaḥ khaḍga dharaḥ kham utpatat |
tapo abhiyogāt ṛṣiḥ ugra vīryavān |
vihāya deham marutām iva ālayam
verses.translation: Leaving the chariot, wielding the bow and sword, that Aksha the chariot-warrior leapt to the sky. Having a terrible power of penance and leaving his body like a sage, he then was seen departing to heaven because of his Yogic penance.

glosses.meaning: having a terrible power of penance

verses.devanagari:
ततः कपिः तम् विचरन्तम् अम्बरे |
पतत्रि राजा अनिल सिद्ध सेविते |
समेत्य तम् मारुत वेग विक्रमः |
क्रमेण जग्राह च पादयोः दृढम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kapiḥ tam vicarantam ambare |
patatri rājā anila siddha sevite |
sametya tam māruta vega vikramaḥ |
krameṇa jagrāha ca pādayoḥ dṛḍham
verses.translation: Thereafter, Hanuma with his prowess equal to that of wind, approaching Aksha moving in the sky, which is often frequented by Garuda the eagle, the wind and Siddhas the ascetics endowed with supernatural powers, slowly grasped his feet firmly.

glosses.meaning: with a prowess equal to that of wind
often frequented by Garuda the eagel

verses.devanagari:
स तम् समाविध्य सहस्रशः कपिः |
महाउरगम् गृह्य इव अण्डज ईश्वरः |
मुमोच वेगात् पितृ तुल्य विक्रमो |
मही तले सम्यति वानर उत्तमः
verses.iast:
sa tam samāvidhya sahasraśaḥ kapiḥ |
mahāuragam gṛhya iva aṇḍaja īśvaraḥ |
mumoca vegāt pitṛ tulya vikramo |
mahī tale samyati vānara uttamaḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma, with a prowess equal to that of wind-god, his father, and the excellent one among monkeys, spigning round Aksha like grasping a great serpent an eagle for a thousand times in the battle, hurled him down to the floor rapidly.

glosses.meaning: having a prowess equal to the wind-god
and the excellent one among the monkeys

verses.devanagari:
स भग्न बाहु ऊरु कटी शिरो धरः |
क्षरन्न् असृन् निर्मथित अस्थि लोचनः |
स भिन्न संधिः प्रविकीर्ण बन्धनो |
हतः क्षितौ वायु सुतेन राक्षसः
verses.iast:
sa bhagna bāhu ūru kaṭī śiro dharaḥ |
kṣarann asṛn nirmathita asthi locanaḥ |
sa bhinna saṃdhiḥ pravikīrṇa bandhano |
hataḥ kṣitau vāyu sutena rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: With his arms, thighs, hips and neck broken, blood dripping, his bones and eyes crushed, his joints displaced and his sinews shattered, that demon was killed by Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: with his bones and eyes crushed

verses.devanagari:
महाकपिः भूमि तले निपीड्य तम् |
चकार रक्षो अधिपतेः महत् भयम् |
महर्षिभिः चक्र चरैः महाव्रतैः |
समेत्य भूतैः च सयाक्ष पन्नगैः |
सुरैः च स इन्द्रैः भृश जात विस्मयैः |
हते कुमारे स कपिः निरीक्षितः
verses.iast:
mahākapiḥ bhūmi tale nipīḍya tam |
cakāra rakṣo adhipateḥ mahat bhayam |
maharṣibhiḥ cakra caraiḥ mahāvrataiḥ |
sametya bhūtaiḥ ca sayākṣa pannagaiḥ |
suraiḥ ca sa indraiḥ bhṛśa jāta vismayaiḥ |
hate kumāre sa kapiḥ nirīkṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Hanuma, having crushed him on the ground, created a great fear to Ravana. Aksha, thus having been killed, Hanuma was gazed on with excessive astonishment by great sages who move everywhere without obstruction and having great voes as also by spirits Yakshas the semidivine beings, Pannagas the serpent-demons and by celestials with Indra the lord of celestials.

glosses.meaning: alog with Yakshas the semi-divine beings and Pannagas the serpent-demons
together with Indra the lord of celestials.

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य तम् वज्र सुत उपम प्रभम् |
कुमारम् अक्षम् क्षतज उपम ईक्षणम् |
तत् एव वीरो अभिजगाम तोरणम् |
कृत क्षणः काल इव प्रजा क्षये
verses.iast:
nihatya tam vajra suta upama prabham |
kumāram akṣam kṣataja upama īkṣaṇam |
tat eva vīro abhijagāma toraṇam |
kṛta kṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajā kṣaye
verses.translation: Killing that Aksha, possessing a lustre equal to that of Jayanta the son of Indra the lord of celestials and having his eyes resembling blood, the heroic Hanuma reached the same archy door way again, like Yama the lord of death expecting in a moment any mortal getting destroyed by him.

glosses.meaning: with a lustre equal to that of Jayantha the son of Indra
and having eyes equal to blood
like Yama the lord of death
